```{r module-4-conversion-dgp, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 1. UTILITY FUNCTIONS
safe_divide <- function( numerator, denominator
) {
  output_length <- max( length( numerator ), length( denominator ) )
  numerator_recycled <- rep_len( numerator, output_length )
  denominator_recycled <- rep_len( denominator, output_length )
  result <- numerator_recycled / denominator_recycled
  invalid_denominator <- is.na( denominator_recycled ) | denominator_recycled == 0
  result[ invalid_denominator ] <- NA_real_
  result
}
check_required_columns <- function( data, required_columns, data_name
) {
  missing_columns <- setdiff( required_columns, names( data ) )
  if ( length( missing_columns ) > 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( data_name, " is missing required columns: ", paste( missing_columns, collapse = ", " ) ) )
  }
}
assert_required_files <- function( files, context
) {
  missing_files <- files[ !file.exists( files ) ]
  if ( length( missing_files ) > 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( context, " is missing required file(s): ", paste( missing_files, collapse = "; " ) ) )
  }
}
assert_nonblank_columns <- function( data, columns, data_name
) {
  for ( field_name in columns
  ) {
    invalid <- is.na( data[[field_name]] ) | trimws( as.character( data[[field_name]] ) ) == ""
    if ( any( invalid )
    ) {
      stop( paste0( field_name, " contains ", sum( invalid ), " missing or blank value(s) in ", data_name, "." ) )
    }
  }
}
clip_probability <- function( probability, epsilon = config$probability_clip
) {
  pmin( pmax( probability, epsilon ), 1 - epsilon )
}
lognormal_parameters_from_mean_cv <- function( arithmetic_mean, coefficient_of_variation
) {
  sigma2 <- log( 1 + coefficient_of_variation^2 )
  sigma <- sqrt( sigma2 )
  mu <- log( arithmetic_mean ) - 0.5 * sigma2
  list( meanlog = mu, sdlog = sigma )
}
log_sum_exp <- function( x
) {
  maximum_x <- max( x )
  maximum_x + log( sum( exp( x - maximum_x ) ) )
}
calibrate_logit_intercept <- function( linear_predictor_without_intercept, target_mean
) {
  objective <- function( intercept
  ) {
    mean( plogis( intercept + linear_predictor_without_intercept ) ) - target_mean
  }
  lower_value <- objective( -15 )
  upper_value <- objective( 15 )
  if ( lower_value * upper_value > 0
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Unable to calibrate logit intercept to target mean ", target_mean,
        ". Expand the root-search interval." ) )
  }
  uniroot( objective, interval = c( -15, 15 ), tol = 1e-10 )$root
}
```

```{r module-4-conversion-dgp, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 6. DEMAND-SCENARIO REGISTER
# All numerical values in this register are scenario assumptions rather than
# empirical estimates.
# The baseline is designed to produce:
#   - a meaningful but not deterministic price response;
#   - stronger conversion for better quote position;
#   - customer-level heterogeneity in price sensitivity;
#   - nonlinear penalties when quotes become materially uncompetitive; and
#   - sufficient latent taste heterogeneity that price alone does not determine
#     the chosen insurer.
# The three sensitivity scenarios alter the shape of demand while the focal
# expected-conversion level is recalibrated to the same 18% target. This makes
# comparisons focus on elasticity/decision structure rather than a mechanical
# shift in the aggregate baseline conversion level.
demand_scenario_register <- tribble( ~demand_scenario_id, ~demand_scenario_label, ~demand_scenario_description,
  ~target_market_purchase_rate, ~target_focal_conversion_rate, ~participation_market_price_sensitivity,
  ~mean_choice_price_sensitivity, ~choice_price_sensitivity_cv, ~rank_salience_scale, ~price_threshold_ratio,
  ~price_threshold_strength, ~rank_threshold, ~rank_threshold_strength, ~taste_shock_sd, "baseline",
  "Baseline demand", paste( "Moderate heterogeneous price sensitivity, quote-rank salience,",
    "nonlinear tolerance penalties and non-price taste heterogeneity." ), 0.78, 0.18, 0.75, 7.0, 0.35, 1.00, 1.08,
  0.65, 4, 0.10, 0.35, "low_price_sensitivity", "Low price sensitivity", paste(
    "Weaker own/relative-price and rank response with stronger", "non-price preference heterogeneity." ), 0.78,
  0.18, 0.50, 4.0, 0.40, 0.60, 1.10, 0.35, 5, 0.05, 0.50, "agentic", "Agent-mediated demand", paste(
    "Lower search friction with stronger price and rank salience,",
    "a tighter price-tolerance threshold and lower non-price noise." ), 0.78, 0.18, 0.90, 10.0, 0.25, 1.35, 1.06,
  0.95, 3, 0.16, 0.22, "threshold", "Threshold demand", paste(
    "Moderate smooth price response but a sharp nonlinear penalty after",
    "relative-price and rank tolerance thresholds are breached." ), 0.78, 0.18, 0.70, 6.0, 0.30, 0.80, 1.05, 1.70,
  3, 0.34, 0.30 )
```

```{r module-4-conversion-dgp, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 8. BUILD COMMON PROFILE-LEVEL RANDOM NUMBERS
# The ordering is fixed before random draws are generated so that Module 7
# receives common random numbers when it reruns this file under different
# demand scenarios.
profile_random_base <- quote_market %>% arrange( quote_profile_id ) %>% dplyr::select( policy_id, quote_profile_id
  )
set.seed(
  config$profile_price_sensitivity_seed )
profile_random_base$price_sensitivity_z <- rnorm( nrow( profile_random_base ) )
set.seed(
  config$purchase_draw_seed )
profile_random_base$purchase_uniform <- runif( nrow( profile_random_base ) )
set.seed(
  config$choice_draw_seed )
profile_random_base$choice_uniform <- runif( nrow( profile_random_base ) )
```

```{r module-4-conversion-dgp, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 10. NON-PRICE ALTERNATIVE UTILITY
# These utilities are deliberately modest. They prevent a pure lowest-price
# winner-takes-all mechanism while preserving price and market position as major
# determinants of conditional choice.
# The specialist interactions use only observable characteristics and represent
# stylised affinity/appetite rather than real insurer behaviour.
calculate_nonprice_utility <- function( alternative_archetype, driver_age, vehicle_value, prior_claims_5yr,
    claim_free_years
) {
  case_when( alternative_archetype == "Focal insurer" ~ 0.00, alternative_archetype == "Value Direct" ~ -0.04,
    alternative_archetype == "Mainstream Alpha" ~ 0.08, alternative_archetype == "Mainstream Beta" ~ 0.04,
    alternative_archetype == "Premium Brand" & vehicle_value >= 45000 & driver_age >= 35 & driver_age <= 69 ~ 0.18,
    alternative_archetype == "Premium Brand" ~ 0.09, alternative_archetype == "Young Driver Specialist" &
      driver_age <= 29 ~ 0.20, alternative_archetype == "Young Driver Specialist" ~ -0.04, alternative_archetype ==
      "Low-Risk Specialist" & prior_claims_5yr == 0 & claim_free_years >= 3 ~ 0.18, alternative_archetype ==
      "Low-Risk Specialist" & prior_claims_5yr >= 2 ~ -0.08, alternative_archetype == "Low-Risk Specialist" ~ 0.03,
    TRUE ~ 0 )
}
```


```{r module-4-conversion-dgp, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 11. GENERATE ONE DEMAND SCENARIO
generate_demand_scenario <- function( requested_demand_scenario_id
) {
  scenario_row <- demand_scenario_register %>% filter( .data$demand_scenario_id ==
        .env$requested_demand_scenario_id )
  if ( nrow( scenario_row ) != 1L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Demand-scenario lookup failed for: ", requested_demand_scenario_id ) )
  }
  # 11.1 Profile-level heterogeneous price sensitivity
  price_sensitivity_parameters <- lognormal_parameters_from_mean_cv( arithmetic_mean =
        scenario_row$mean_choice_price_sensitivity[ 1 ], coefficient_of_variation =
        scenario_row$choice_price_sensitivity_cv[ 1 ] )
  profile_scenario <- quote_market %>% arrange( quote_profile_id ) %>% left_join( profile_random_base, by = c(
        "policy_id", "quote_profile_id" ) ) %>% mutate( demand_scenario_id = requested_demand_scenario_id,
      true_choice_price_sensitivity = exp( price_sensitivity_parameters$meanlog +
            price_sensitivity_parameters$sdlog * price_sensitivity_z ) )
  # 11.2 Stage A: market participation
  portfolio_market_median <- median( profile_scenario$market_median_quote )
  profile_scenario <- profile_scenario %>% mutate( participation_market_price_index = log( market_median_quote /
            portfolio_market_median ), participation_age_effect = case_when( driver_age <= 24 ~ -0.12,
          driver_age <= 34 ~ 0.02, driver_age <= 69 ~ 0.10, driver_age <= 79 ~ 0.02, TRUE ~ -0.06 ),
      participation_claim_history_effect = 0.035 * pmin( prior_claims_5yr, 3 ),
      participation_linear_predictor_without_intercept = -scenario_row$participation_market_price_sensitivity[ 1
        ] * participation_market_price_index + participation_age_effect + participation_claim_history_effect )
  participation_intercept <- calibrate_logit_intercept( linear_predictor_without_intercept =
        profile_scenario$participation_linear_predictor_without_intercept, target_mean =
        scenario_row$target_market_purchase_rate[ 1 ] )
  profile_scenario <- profile_scenario %>% mutate( true_market_purchase_probability = clip_probability( plogis(
            participation_intercept + participation_linear_predictor_without_intercept ) ), market_purchase =
        purchase_uniform < true_market_purchase_probability )
  # 11.3 Alternative-level utility before focal brand calibration
  alternative_scenario <- alternative_base %>% left_join( profile_scenario %>% dplyr::select( policy_id,
          quote_profile_id, driver_age, vehicle_value, prior_claims_5yr, claim_free_years,
          true_choice_price_sensitivity, true_market_purchase_probability, choice_uniform ), by = c( "policy_id",
        "quote_profile_id" ) ) %>% mutate( demand_scenario_id = requested_demand_scenario_id,
      base_nonprice_utility = calculate_nonprice_utility( alternative_archetype = alternative_archetype,
          driver_age = driver_age, vehicle_value = vehicle_value, prior_claims_5yr = prior_claims_5yr,
          claim_free_years = claim_free_years ), latent_taste_utility = scenario_row$taste_shock_sd[ 1 ] *
          latent_taste_z, smooth_price_utility = -true_choice_price_sensitivity * log( alternative_relative_price
          ), rank_salience_utility = scenario_row$rank_salience_scale[ 1 ] * case_when( alternative_rank == 1 ~
              0.55, alternative_rank == 2 ~ 0.26, alternative_rank == 3 ~ 0.10, TRUE ~ 0 ),
      price_threshold_excess = pmax( alternative_relative_price - scenario_row$price_threshold_ratio[ 1 ], 0 ),
      price_threshold_penalty = scenario_row$price_threshold_strength[ 1 ] * ( price_threshold_excess / 0.05 )^2,
      rank_threshold_excess = pmax( alternative_rank - scenario_row$rank_threshold[ 1 ], 0 ),
      rank_threshold_penalty = scenario_row$rank_threshold_strength[ 1 ] * rank_threshold_excess^2,
      utility_before_focal_calibration = base_nonprice_utility + latent_taste_utility + smooth_price_utility +
        rank_salience_utility - price_threshold_penalty - rank_threshold_penalty )
  # 11.4 Calibrate focal brand constant to expected focal conversion target
  choice_calibration_base <- alternative_scenario %>% group_by( policy_id, quote_profile_id ) %>% summarise(
      true_market_purchase_probability = first( true_market_purchase_probability ), focal_base_utility =
        utility_before_focal_calibration[ is_focal ][1], competitor_log_sum_exp = log_sum_exp(
          utility_before_focal_calibration[ !is_focal ] ), .groups = "drop" )
  focal_conversion_objective <- function( focal_brand_constant
  ) {
    focal_choice_probability <- plogis( choice_calibration_base$focal_base_utility + focal_brand_constant -
          choice_calibration_base$competitor_log_sum_exp )
    mean( choice_calibration_base$true_market_purchase_probability * focal_choice_probability ) -
      scenario_row$target_focal_conversion_rate[ 1 ]
  }
  lower_objective <- focal_conversion_objective( -10 )
  upper_objective <- focal_conversion_objective( 10 )
  if ( lower_objective * upper_objective > 0
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Unable to calibrate focal brand utility for demand scenario: ", requested_demand_scenario_id ) )
  }
  focal_brand_constant_scalar <- uniroot( focal_conversion_objective, interval = c( -10, 10 ), tol = 1e-10 )$root
  # 11.5 Final alternative probabilities
  # Each alternative retains its own softmax numerator. The group-level
  # denominator is calculated once and direct vector/scalar division is used.
  # This avoids accidental scalar recycling inside helper functions.
  alternative_scenario <- alternative_scenario %>% mutate( calibrated_focal_brand_utility = if_else( is_focal,
          .env$focal_brand_constant_scalar, 0 ), true_choice_utility = utility_before_focal_calibration +
        calibrated_focal_brand_utility ) %>% group_by( policy_id, quote_profile_id ) %>% mutate( utility_maximum =
        max( true_choice_utility ), choice_probability_numerator = exp( true_choice_utility - utility_maximum ),
      choice_probability_denominator = sum( choice_probability_numerator ),
      # IMPORTANT:
      # Do not use safe_divide() here. The denominator is a single group-level
      # scalar and each alternative must retain its own numerator. Direct
      # division therefore gives the exact profile-level softmax probability.
      true_conditional_choice_probability = choice_probability_numerator / choice_probability_denominator,
      choice_probability_sum = sum( true_conditional_choice_probability ) ) %>% arrange( alternative_id,
      .by_group = TRUE ) %>% mutate( cumulative_choice_probability_raw = cumsum(
          true_conditional_choice_probability ), cumulative_choice_probability = if_else( row_number() == n(), 1,
          cumulative_choice_probability_raw ), previous_cumulative_probability = lag(
          cumulative_choice_probability, default = 0 ), alternative_selected_if_purchase = choice_uniform >
          previous_cumulative_probability & choice_uniform <= cumulative_choice_probability ) %>% ungroup()
  choice_probability_normalisation_check <- alternative_scenario %>% group_by( policy_id, quote_profile_id ) %>%
    summarise( probability_sum = sum( true_conditional_choice_probability ), .groups = "drop" )
  maximum_choice_probability_sum_error <- max( abs( choice_probability_normalisation_check$probability_sum - 1 ) )
  if ( maximum_choice_probability_sum_error > 1e-10
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Conditional choice probabilities do not sum to one. Maximum error = ",
        maximum_choice_probability_sum_error ) )
  }
  selected_alternative_count <- alternative_scenario %>% group_by( policy_id, quote_profile_id ) %>% summarise(
      selected_alternatives = sum( alternative_selected_if_purchase ), .groups = "drop" )
  if ( any( selected_alternative_count$selected_alternatives != 1L )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Conditional insurer-choice simulation failed for demand scenario: ",
        requested_demand_scenario_id ) )
  }
  # 11.6 Profile-level focal truth and realised label
  focal_truth <- alternative_scenario %>% filter( is_focal ) %>% transmute( policy_id, quote_profile_id,
      true_focal_choice_probability = true_conditional_choice_probability, focal_selected_if_purchase =
        alternative_selected_if_purchase, focal_taste_shock = latent_taste_utility, focal_base_nonprice_utility =
        base_nonprice_utility, focal_smooth_price_utility = smooth_price_utility, focal_rank_salience_utility =
        rank_salience_utility, focal_price_threshold_penalty = price_threshold_penalty,
      focal_rank_threshold_penalty = rank_threshold_penalty )
  profile_truth <- profile_scenario %>% left_join( focal_truth, by = c( "policy_id", "quote_profile_id" ) ) %>%
    mutate( scenario_id = market_scenario_id, market_scenario_id = market_scenario_id, demand_scenario_id =
        requested_demand_scenario_id, true_focal_conversion_probability = true_market_purchase_probability *
          true_focal_choice_probability, focal_conversion = as.integer( market_purchase &
            focal_selected_if_purchase ), participation_intercept = participation_intercept,
      calibrated_focal_brand_utility = focal_brand_constant_scalar, target_market_purchase_rate =
        scenario_row$target_market_purchase_rate[ 1 ], target_focal_conversion_rate =
        scenario_row$target_focal_conversion_rate[ 1 ] )
  # 11.7 Leakage-safe Module 5 modelling dataset
  conversion_data <- quote_market %>% mutate( scenario_id = market_scenario_id, market_scenario_id =
        market_scenario_id, demand_scenario_id = requested_demand_scenario_id ) %>% left_join( profile_truth %>%
        dplyr::select( policy_id, quote_profile_id, focal_conversion ), by = c( "policy_id", "quote_profile_id" ) )
  missing_vehicle_specification_columns <- setdiff( vehicle_specification_columns, names( conversion_data ) )
  if ( length( missing_vehicle_specification_columns ) > 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Module 4 failed to retain vehicle-specification columns in conversion_data: ", paste(
          missing_vehicle_specification_columns, collapse = ", " ) ) )
  }
  forbidden_conversion_modelling_columns <- names( conversion_data )[ str_detect( names( conversion_data ), regex(
        paste( c( "^true_", "^latent_", "price_sensitivity_z", "taste_shock", "utility", "purchase_uniform",
            "choice_uniform", "participation_intercept", "calibrated_focal_brand_utility" ), collapse = "|" ),
        ignore_case = TRUE ) ) ]
  if ( length( forbidden_conversion_modelling_columns ) > 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Module 4 leakage-safe output contains forbidden DGP truth columns: ", paste(
          forbidden_conversion_modelling_columns, collapse = ", " ) ) )
  }
  # 11.8 Summary diagnostics
  expected_purchase_rate <- mean( profile_truth$true_market_purchase_probability )
  realised_purchase_rate <- mean( profile_truth$market_purchase )
  expected_focal_conversion_rate <- mean( profile_truth$true_focal_conversion_probability )
  realised_focal_conversion_rate <- mean( profile_truth$focal_conversion )
  expected_conditional_focal_choice_rate <- mean( profile_truth$true_focal_choice_probability )
  realised_conditional_focal_choice_rate <- mean( profile_truth$focal_selected_if_purchase )
  conversion_by_rank <- profile_truth %>% group_by( focal_rank ) %>% summarise( profiles = n(),
      mean_relative_price = mean( relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor ), expected_market_purchase_rate = mean(
          true_market_purchase_probability ), expected_focal_choice_given_purchase = mean(
          true_focal_choice_probability ), expected_focal_conversion_rate = mean( true_focal_conversion_probability
        ), observed_focal_conversion_rate = mean( focal_conversion ), .groups = "drop" )
  conversion_by_relative_price_decile <- profile_truth %>% mutate( relative_price_decile = ntile(
          relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor, 10 ) ) %>% group_by( relative_price_decile ) %>% summarise(
      profiles = n(), mean_relative_price_to_cheapest = mean( relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor ),
      mean_focal_rank = mean( focal_rank ), expected_focal_conversion_rate = mean(
          true_focal_conversion_probability ), observed_focal_conversion_rate = mean( focal_conversion ), .groups =
        "drop" )
  conversion_by_split <- profile_truth %>% group_by( conversion_data_split ) %>% summarise( profiles = n(),
      conversions = sum( focal_conversion ), nonconversions = sum( focal_conversion == 0L ),
      expected_focal_conversion_rate = mean( true_focal_conversion_probability ), observed_focal_conversion_rate =
        mean( focal_conversion ), .groups = "drop" ) %>% mutate( conversion_data_split = as.character(
          conversion_data_split ) )
  split_value <- function( split_name, field_name
  ) {
    split_row <- conversion_by_split %>% filter( conversion_data_split == split_name )
    if ( nrow( split_row ) != 1L
    ) {
      stop( paste0( "Unable to retrieve conversion split row for ", split_name, "." ) )
    }
    if ( !field_name %in% names( split_row )
    ) {
      stop( paste0( "Unknown conversion split metric: ", field_name, "." ) )
    }
    output <- split_row[[field_name]]
    if ( length( output ) != 1L
    ) {
      stop( paste0( "Unable to retrieve conversion split metric ", field_name, " for ", split_name, "." ) )
    }
    output
  }
  rank_conversion_spearman <- cor( profile_truth$focal_rank, profile_truth$true_focal_conversion_probability,
      method = "spearman" )
  relative_price_conversion_spearman <- cor( profile_truth$relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor,
      profile_truth$true_focal_conversion_probability, method = "spearman" )
  first_rank_expected_conversion <- conversion_by_rank %>% filter( focal_rank == min( focal_rank ) ) %>% pull(
      expected_focal_conversion_rate )
  poor_rank_expected_conversion <- conversion_by_rank %>% filter( focal_rank >= 5 ) %>% summarise( value =
        weighted.mean( expected_focal_conversion_rate, w = profiles ) ) %>% pull( value )
  if ( length( poor_rank_expected_conversion ) == 0L | !is.finite( poor_rank_expected_conversion )
  ) {
    poor_rank_expected_conversion <- NA_real_
  }
  scenario_summary <- tibble( scenario_id = market_scenario_id, demand_scenario_id = requested_demand_scenario_id,
    profiles = nrow( profile_truth ), policy_year = config$expected_policy_year, conversion_train_profiles =
      split_value( "train", "profiles" ), conversion_validation_profiles = split_value( "validation", "profiles" ),
    conversion_test_profiles = split_value( "test", "profiles" ), conversion_train_rate = split_value( "train",
        "observed_focal_conversion_rate" ), conversion_validation_rate = split_value( "validation",
        "observed_focal_conversion_rate" ), conversion_test_rate = split_value( "test",
        "observed_focal_conversion_rate" ), target_market_purchase_rate = scenario_row$target_market_purchase_rate[
        1 ], expected_market_purchase_rate = expected_purchase_rate, realised_market_purchase_rate =
      realised_purchase_rate, target_focal_conversion_rate = scenario_row$target_focal_conversion_rate[ 1 ],
    expected_focal_conversion_rate = expected_focal_conversion_rate, realised_focal_conversion_rate =
      realised_focal_conversion_rate, expected_conditional_focal_choice_rate =
      expected_conditional_focal_choice_rate, realised_conditional_focal_choice_rate =
      realised_conditional_focal_choice_rate, mean_true_choice_price_sensitivity = mean(
        profile_truth$true_choice_price_sensitivity ), sd_true_choice_price_sensitivity = sd(
        profile_truth$true_choice_price_sensitivity ), participation_intercept = participation_intercept,
    calibrated_focal_brand_utility = focal_brand_constant_scalar, rank_conversion_spearman =
      rank_conversion_spearman, relative_price_conversion_spearman = relative_price_conversion_spearman,
    first_rank_expected_conversion = first_rank_expected_conversion, poor_rank_expected_conversion =
      poor_rank_expected_conversion )
  # 11.9 Validation checks
  scenario_validation_checks <- tribble( ~scenario_id, ~demand_scenario_id, ~check_name, ~observed_value,
    ~lower_bound, ~upper_bound, market_scenario_id, requested_demand_scenario_id, "Conversion modelling rows",
    nrow( conversion_data ), nrow( quote_market ), nrow( quote_market ), market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Unique quote-profile IDs", n_distinct( conversion_data$quote_profile_id ), nrow(
      quote_market ), nrow( quote_market ), market_scenario_id, requested_demand_scenario_id, "Truth rows", nrow(
      profile_truth ), nrow( quote_market ), nrow( quote_market ), market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Policy year is 2025 only", as.numeric( all( conversion_data$policy_year ==
          config$expected_policy_year ) ), 1, 1, market_scenario_id, requested_demand_scenario_id,
    "Technical-pricing provenance remains TEST only", as.numeric( all( conversion_data$technical_data_split ==
          "test" ) ), 1, 1, market_scenario_id, requested_demand_scenario_id,
    "Downstream data_split matches conversion_data_split", as.numeric( all( as.character(
          conversion_data$data_split ) == as.character( conversion_data$conversion_data_split ) ) ), 1, 1,
    market_scenario_id, requested_demand_scenario_id, "Conversion TRAIN rows", split_value( "train", "profiles" ),
    config$expected_conversion_train_rows, config$expected_conversion_train_rows, market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Conversion VALIDATION rows", split_value( "validation", "profiles" ),
    config$expected_conversion_validation_rows, config$expected_conversion_validation_rows, market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Conversion TEST rows", split_value( "test", "profiles" ),
    config$expected_conversion_test_rows, config$expected_conversion_test_rows, market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Conversion TRAIN contains both outcome classes", as.numeric( split_value(
        "train", "conversions" ) > 0 & split_value( "train", "nonconversions" ) > 0 ), 1, 1, market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Conversion VALIDATION contains both outcome classes", as.numeric( split_value(
        "validation", "conversions" ) > 0 & split_value( "validation", "nonconversions" ) > 0 ), 1, 1,
    market_scenario_id, requested_demand_scenario_id, "Conversion TEST contains both outcome classes", as.numeric(
      split_value( "test", "conversions" ) > 0 & split_value( "test", "nonconversions" ) > 0 ), 1, 1,
    market_scenario_id, requested_demand_scenario_id, "Vehicle specification columns retained", as.numeric( all(
        vehicle_specification_columns %in% names( conversion_data ) ) ), 1, 1, market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Positive power retained in conversion data", mean( is.finite(
        conversion_data$power_kw ) & conversion_data$power_kw > 0 ), 1, 1, market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Positive torque retained in conversion data", mean( is.finite(
        conversion_data$torque_nm ) & conversion_data$torque_nm > 0 ), 1, 1, market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Positive unladen weight retained in conversion data", mean( is.finite(
        conversion_data$unladen_weight_kg ) & conversion_data$unladen_weight_kg > 0 ), 1, 1, market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Nonblank transmission retained in conversion data", mean( !is.na(
        conversion_data$transmission ) & trimws( as.character( conversion_data$transmission ) ) != "" ), 1, 1,
    market_scenario_id, requested_demand_scenario_id, "Finite true focal conversion probabilities", mean(
      is.finite( profile_truth$true_focal_conversion_probability ) ), 1, 1, market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "True focal conversion probabilities inside [0,1]", mean(
      profile_truth$true_focal_conversion_probability >= 0 & profile_truth$true_focal_conversion_probability <= 1
    ), 1, 1, market_scenario_id, requested_demand_scenario_id, "Positive heterogeneous price sensitivity", mean(
      is.finite( profile_truth$true_choice_price_sensitivity ) & profile_truth$true_choice_price_sensitivity > 0 ),
    1, 1, market_scenario_id, requested_demand_scenario_id, "Expected market purchase rate",
    expected_purchase_rate, scenario_row$target_market_purchase_rate[ 1 ] - config$expected_purchase_tolerance,
    scenario_row$target_market_purchase_rate[ 1 ] + config$expected_purchase_tolerance, market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Expected focal conversion rate", expected_focal_conversion_rate,
    scenario_row$target_focal_conversion_rate[ 1 ] - config$expected_conversion_tolerance,
    scenario_row$target_focal_conversion_rate[ 1 ] + config$expected_conversion_tolerance, market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Observed focal conversion reasonably close to expectation",
    realised_focal_conversion_rate, expected_focal_conversion_rate - config$observed_conversion_tolerance,
    expected_focal_conversion_rate + config$observed_conversion_tolerance, market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Conditional choice probabilities sum to one",
    maximum_choice_probability_sum_error, 0, 1e-10, market_scenario_id, requested_demand_scenario_id,
    "Realised conditional focal choice close to expectation", realised_conditional_focal_choice_rate,
    expected_conditional_focal_choice_rate - config$observed_conversion_tolerance,
    expected_conditional_focal_choice_rate + config$observed_conversion_tolerance, market_scenario_id,
    requested_demand_scenario_id, "Rank has negative association with true conversion", rank_conversion_spearman,
    -1, -0.20, market_scenario_id, requested_demand_scenario_id,
    "Relative price has negative association with true conversion", relative_price_conversion_spearman, -1, -0.20,
    market_scenario_id, requested_demand_scenario_id, "Rank 1 expected conversion exceeds poorer ranks",
    first_rank_expected_conversion - poor_rank_expected_conversion, 0.03, 1 ) %>% mutate( pass = observed_value >=
          lower_bound & observed_value <= upper_bound )
  # 11.10 Alternative truth output for later counterfactual evaluation
  alternative_truth <- alternative_scenario %>% dplyr::select( policy_id, quote_profile_id, alternative_id,
      alternative_archetype, is_focal, alternative_quote, alternative_rank, alternative_relative_price,
      market_cheapest_quote, market_median_quote_reconstructed, latent_taste_z, base_nonprice_utility,
      latent_taste_utility, smooth_price_utility, rank_salience_utility, price_threshold_excess,
      price_threshold_penalty, rank_threshold_excess, rank_threshold_penalty, calibrated_focal_brand_utility,
      utility_before_focal_calibration, true_choice_utility, choice_probability_numerator,
      choice_probability_denominator, choice_probability_sum, true_conditional_choice_probability ) %>% mutate(
      scenario_id = market_scenario_id, market_scenario_id = market_scenario_id, demand_scenario_id =
        requested_demand_scenario_id, .before = 1 )
  # 11.11 Scenario metadata
  scenario_metadata <- list( market_scenario_id = market_scenario_id, demand_scenario_id =
      requested_demand_scenario_id, quote_market_policy_year = config$expected_policy_year, quote_market_profiles =
      config$expected_profiles, technical_data_split = "test", conversion_split_counts = c( train =
          config$expected_conversion_train_rows, validation = config$expected_conversion_validation_rows, test =
          config$expected_conversion_test_rows ), demand_parameters = as.list( scenario_row[ 1, ] ),
    participation_intercept = participation_intercept, calibrated_focal_brand_utility =
      focal_brand_constant_scalar, portfolio_market_median = portfolio_market_median, price_sensitivity_meanlog =
      price_sensitivity_parameters$meanlog, price_sensitivity_sdlog = price_sensitivity_parameters$sdlog,
    common_random_number_seeds = list( profile_price_sensitivity_seed = config$profile_price_sensitivity_seed,
        alternative_taste_seed = config$alternative_taste_seed, purchase_draw_seed = config$purchase_draw_seed,
        choice_draw_seed = config$choice_draw_seed ), extensive_margin_assumption = paste(
        "Market participation depends on the full-market median quote.",
        "Focal repricing affects market participation only when it changes",
        "the market median; otherwise repricing acts through conditional insurer choice." ) )
  list( conversion_data = conversion_data, profile_truth = profile_truth, alternative_truth = alternative_truth,
    scenario_summary = scenario_summary, conversion_by_rank = conversion_by_rank,
    conversion_by_relative_price_decile = conversion_by_relative_price_decile, conversion_by_split =
      conversion_by_split, validation_checks = scenario_validation_checks, metadata = scenario_metadata )
}
```

```{r module-4-conversion-dgp, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 12. RUN REQUESTED DEMAND SCENARIOS
demand_results <- purrr::set_names( config$demand_scenarios_to_run ) %>% purrr::map( generate_demand_scenario )
```

```{r module-4-conversion-dgp, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 13. CONSOLIDATED SUMMARIES AND VALIDATION
conversion_generation_summary <- purrr::map_dfr( demand_results, "scenario_summary" )
conversion_generation_validation_checks <- purrr::map_dfr( demand_results, "validation_checks" )
conversion_by_rank_all <- purrr::imap_dfr( demand_results, function( scenario_result, scenario_name
    ) {
      scenario_result$conversion_by_rank %>% mutate( scenario_id = market_scenario_id, demand_scenario_id =
            scenario_name, .before = 1 )
    } )
conversion_by_relative_price_decile_all <- purrr::imap_dfr( demand_results, function( scenario_result,
        scenario_name
    ) {
      scenario_result$conversion_by_relative_price_decile %>% mutate( scenario_id = market_scenario_id,
          demand_scenario_id = scenario_name, .before = 1 )
    } )
conversion_by_split_all <- purrr::imap_dfr( demand_results, function( scenario_result, scenario_name
    ) {
      scenario_result$conversion_by_split %>% mutate( scenario_id = market_scenario_id, demand_scenario_id =
            scenario_name, .before = 1 )
    } )
if ( any( is.na( conversion_generation_validation_checks$pass ) | !conversion_generation_validation_checks$pass )
) {
  failed_conversion_checks <- conversion_generation_validation_checks %>% filter( is.na( pass ) | !pass )
  stop( paste0( "Module 4 validation failed. Resolve these checks before running Module 5: ", paste( paste0(
          failed_conversion_checks$demand_scenario_id, " / ", failed_conversion_checks$check_name ),
        collapse = "; " ) ) )
}
```

```{r module-4-conversion-dgp, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
readr::write_csv( conversion_by_relative_price_decile_all, file.path( config$output_dir,
    "conversion_by_relative_price_decile.csv" ) )
readr::write_csv( market_median_reconstruction_check, file.path( config$output_dir,
    "market_median_reconstruction_check.csv" ) )
readr::write_csv( conversion_vehicle_specification_audit, file.path( config$output_dir,
    "conversion_vehicle_specification_audit.csv" ) )
```

```{r module-4-conversion-dgp, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 17. DIAGNOSTIC PLOTS
if ( isTRUE( config$write_plots )
) {
  plot_scenario <- if ( "baseline" %in% names( demand_results )
    ) {
      "baseline"
    } else {
      names( demand_results )[ 1 ]
    }
  plot_truth <- demand_results[[plot_scenario]]$profile_truth
  plot_rank <- demand_results[[plot_scenario]]$conversion_by_rank
  plot_price_decile <- demand_results[[plot_scenario]]$conversion_by_relative_price_decile
  p_probability_distribution <- ggplot( plot_truth, aes( x = true_focal_conversion_probability ) ) +
    geom_histogram( bins = 50 ) + labs( x = "True focal conversion probability", y = "Quote profiles",
      title = "Synthetic focal-conversion probability distribution" ) + theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "01_true_conversion_probability.png" ), p_probability_distribution,
    width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300 )
  p_conversion_by_rank <- plot_rank %>% dplyr::select( focal_rank, expected_focal_conversion_rate,
      observed_focal_conversion_rate ) %>% pivot_longer( cols = c( expected_focal_conversion_rate,
        observed_focal_conversion_rate ), names_to = "series", values_to = "conversion_rate" ) %>% mutate( series =
        recode( series, expected_focal_conversion_rate = "Expected from DGP", observed_focal_conversion_rate =
            "Realised binary labels" ) ) %>% ggplot( aes( x = focal_rank, y = conversion_rate, linetype = series )
    ) + geom_line() + geom_point() + labs( x = "Focal quote rank", y = "Conversion rate", linetype = NULL,
      title = "Conversion by focal quote rank" ) + theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "02_conversion_by_rank.png" ), p_conversion_by_rank, width = 8, height = 5,
    dpi = 300 )
  p_conversion_by_relative_price <- plot_price_decile %>% ggplot( aes( x = mean_relative_price_to_cheapest, y =
          expected_focal_conversion_rate ) ) + geom_line() + geom_point() + labs(
      x = "Mean focal quote / cheapest competitor quote", y = "Expected focal conversion rate",
      title = "True conversion response to relative price" ) + theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "03_conversion_by_relative_price.png" ), p_conversion_by_relative_price,
    width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300 )
  p_price_sensitivity <- ggplot( plot_truth, aes( x = true_choice_price_sensitivity ) ) + geom_histogram( bins = 50
    ) + labs( x = "True customer price sensitivity", y = "Quote profiles",
      title = "Heterogeneous customer price sensitivity" ) + theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "04_price_sensitivity_distribution.png" ), p_price_sensitivity, width = 8,
    height = 5, dpi = 300 )
}
```
